title: Juice N Power Cherry Ice Power Salt 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Juice N Power’s Cherry Ice is a bold blend of luscious, sweet cherries and invigorating menthol, delivering a taste that’s irresistibly sweet and satisfying while also being deliciously refreshing. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
